preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the permutation arrays A and P must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations Q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= N for i in range(N)) and all(1 <= P[i] <= N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in arrays A and P must be distinct integers from 1 to N.
The sum of N and the sum of Q over all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: For each type 3 operation, the output must be the element at position x in array A after all preceding operations.
